```{r}
# Reading the Address Master data and property listing data
Address_Master <- st_read("dataset/LIST_ADDRESS_POINTS_STATEWIDE/list_address_points_statewide.shp")
property_listing_domain<- read_csv("dataset/property_listing.csv")
Address_Master$ST_NO_FROM <- as.character(Address_Master$ST_NO_FROM)
Address_Master$POSTCODE <- as.character(Address_Master$POSTCODE)
```


```{r}
#  Creating / opening a database file
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "TESM.duckdb", read_only = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Writing the municipality data to DuckDB as tables.
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")

# List of municipality object names already in R
muni_names <- c(
  "parcels_break_o_day",
  "parcels_brighton",
  "parcels_burnie",
  "parcels_central_coast",
  "parcels_central_highlands",
  "parcels_circular_head",
  "parcels_clarence",
  "parcels_derwent_valley",
  "parcels_devonport",
  "parcels_dorset",
  "parcels_flinders",
  "parcels_george_town",
  "parcels_glamorgan_spring_bay",
  "parcels_glenorchy",
  "parcels_hobart",
  "parcels_huon_valley",
  "parcels_kentish",
  "parcels_kingborough",
  "parcels_king_island",
  "parcels_latrobe",
  "parcels_launceston",
  "parcels_meander_valley",
  "parcels_northern_midlands",
  "parcels_sorell",
  "parcels_southern_midlands",
  "parcels_tasman",
  "parcels_waratah_wynyard",
  "parcels_west_coast",
  "parcels_west_tamar"
)

# Loop through each object, convert + write to DuckDB
for (muni in muni_names) {
  message("Processing: ", muni)
  
  # Get the sf object from environment
  sf_obj <- get(muni, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  # Convert to plain data frame with WKB geometry
  df <- sf_obj |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    as.data.frame()
  df$geometry <- st_as_binary(sf_obj$geometry)
  
  # Write to DuckDB with same name as in R
  dbWriteTable(con, muni, df, overwrite = TRUE)
}

```

```{r}
# Build SQL string with UNION ALL
sql_parts <- lapply(muni_names, function(tbl) {
  muni_name <- toupper(gsub("^parcels_", "", tbl))   # e.g. "parcels_hobart" -> "HOBART"
  
  paste0(
    "SELECT PID, * EXCLUDE(PID), '", muni_name, "' AS MUNICIPALITY ",
    "FROM ", tbl, " ",
    "WHERE PID <> 0"
  )
})

master_sql <- paste(sql_parts, collapse = "\nUNION ALL\n")

# Wrap into CREATE TABLE
create_master_sql <- paste0(
  "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE CADASTRAL_MASTER AS\n",
  master_sql,
  ";"
)

# Run in DuckDB
dbExecute(con, create_master_sql)
```


```{r}
#  Addding index and set geometry column as binary.
address_master_tbl <- Address_Master |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  as.data.frame()

# Then add a WKB geometry column from the original sf object
address_master_tbl$geometry <- st_as_binary(Address_Master$geometry)

# loading the data into ducykdb tables.
dbWriteTable(con, "ADDRESS_MASTER",address_master_tbl, overwrite = TRUE)

dbWriteTable(con, "PROPERTY_LISTING", property_listing_domain, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}

# useful indexes in order to reduce the processing time.  
dbExecute(con, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_parcels_pid ON CADASTRAL_MASTER(PID)")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_parcels_muncipality ON CADASTRAL_MASTER(MUNICIPALITY)")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_addr_pid    ON ADDRESS_MASTER(PID)")
dbExecute(con, "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_listing_pid ON PROPERTY_LISTING(full_address)")

```

```{sql, connection=con}
# creaating a master table by joining the cadstral master and address master tables.
CREATE  OR REPLACE TABLE CADASTRAL_ADDRESS_MASTER AS select distinct(P.PID
),P.MUNICIPALITY, concat(
    cast(A.ST_NO_FROM as varchar), ' ', A.STREET, ' ', A.ST_TYPE, ' ', A.LOCALITY, ' TAS ', A.POSTCODE, ' Australia'
) as FULL_ADDRESS,ANY_VALUE(P.geometry) as parcel_geometry,P.POT_PID, ANY_VALUE(A.geometry) as address_geometry
from CADASTRAL_MASTER P inner join ADDRESS_MASTER A on P.PID = A.PID where P.PID !='0' group by P.PID,P.MUNICIPALITY, FULL_ADDRESS,P.POT_PID;
```


```{sql, connection=con}
# creating the final master table by joining the property listing data with cadstral address master table.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE PROPERTY_MASTER AS
SELECT
  p.PID,
  p.POT_PID,  
  p.MUNICIPALITY,
  d.full_address as FULL_ADDRESS,
  d.price_numeric as PRICE,
  ST_AsText(ST_GeomFromWKB(p.parcel_geometry))  AS PARCEL_WKT,
  ST_AsText(ST_GeomFromWKB(p.address_geometry)) AS ADDRESS_WKT,
  d.Listing_URL as Domain_URL
FROM PROPERTY_LISTING d
JOIN CADASTRAL_ADDRESS_MASTER p
  ON upper(trim(replace(d.full_address, chr(160), ' '))) =
     upper(trim(replace(p.full_address, chr(160), ' '))) where POT_PID!=0;
```

```{r}
# Load the table into an R data frame
cadastral_df <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM PROPERTY_MASTER")
# Save the combined file in two spots:
# one in 'data set' for transformation (pixel counting),
# and another in 'results' for output reference.
write_csv(cadastral_df, "dataset/cadastral_master_26925.csv")
write_csv(cadastral_df, "results/PROPERTY_MASTER.csv")
```
